questions.q_en: A triangular glacier-view sign has base 14 cm and perpendicular height 9 cm. What is its area in cm²?
questions.q_zh: 一块三角形冰川观景牌底边 14 厘米，对应高 9 厘米，面积几平方厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Of 150 summit photos, 18% show the Spearhead Range. How many photos show it?
questions.q_zh: 150 张山顶照片中有 18% 拍到矛头山脉，共几张？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the hut, blue and red mugs are in the ratio 3:2. There are 35 mugs altogether. How many are blue?
questions.q_zh: 小屋里蓝杯与红杯的数量比为 3:2，共有 35 个杯子，蓝杯几个？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: For a summit snow survey, Flora packs 4 bags of 2.5 kg each and one 1.8 kg kit. What is the total mass in kg?
questions.q_zh: 去山顶做积雪调查，Flora 装了 4 袋每袋 2.5 千克的用品，另有一套 1.8 千克的工具，总质量几千克？

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: In the cold summit air, snow changes directly into water vapour without becoming liquid. What is this process?
questions.q_zh: 山顶寒冷的空气中，雪不经过液态直接变成水蒸气，这是什么过程？
questions.explain_en: Sublimation changes a solid directly into a gas.
questions.explain_zh: 升华是固体直接变成气体的过程。
questions.qtype_zh: 相变与热量（升华/潜热/吸热）

questions.subject: culture
questions.q_en: Beside the 7th Heaven inukshuk, Flora reads about Inuit landmarks. Which description is accurate?
questions.q_zh: 在第七天堂的石头人旁，Flora 阅读因纽特地标介绍，哪项正确？
choices: An inukshuk must be made of metal
An inukshuk is a living animal
An inukshuk can guide travellers as a stone landmark
Every inukshuk is a weather machine
choices_zh: 石头人必须由金属制成
石头人可作为石头地标为旅行者指路
每座石头人都是天气机器
questions.explain_en: Inuksuit are Inuit stone landmarks with uses including guidance.
questions.explain_zh: 因纽特石头人是石头地标，用途包括指路。
